title: A Retire-run cite on a lane tip the batch contains is deferred to merge.
ruling: Coordinator ruling, 2026-11-07 20:03 CST, design approved 20:04 CST: lint/check_debt_retire.py judge_run defers a cited run on a strict ancestor of the head (a lane tip the batch contains). In CI the silent-undo CLI excuses it with a deferred to merge note. In the merge tool it holds only when the head's own checks.yml run is green; a pending, red or missing run is refused.
